rust_spore_cap.read: upright mushroom, cap wider than the stalk, cracked
rust_spore_cap.silhouette: cap occupies rows 3-8 spanning 10px; stalk 3px wide, rows 9-13
rust_spore_cap.detail: 3-4 hazard-orange cracks radiating from the cap crown; brightest pixel at each crack mouth, never more than 6 accent pixels total
rust_spore_cap.anim: none (still node art doubles the icon)

nightshade_bramble.read: thorny vine arcing bottom-left to top-right, berries reading first
nightshade_bramble.silhouette: vine 2px wide with 4 outward barbs; 3 berries clustered upper right
nightshade_bramble.detail: berries pulse: 2-frame idle swapping berry_mid and berry_glow, 0.5s per frame

magma_root.read: gnarled forked root, dark, lit from inside
magma_root.silhouette: thick vertical root rows 2-14, two side forks, never symmetric
magma_root.detail: veins run ALONG the root's length, never across it; hottest pixels deepest in the crevices so the light reads as internal

sun_lit_lotus.read: symmetrical 8-petal flower seen from directly above
sun_lit_lotus.silhouette: petals on the 8 compass points, tips at the 16px edge, core 4x4 centred
sun_lit_lotus.detail: the ONLY radially symmetric herb in the set — symmetry is its read, so mirror all four quadrants exactly; core is pure white with a 1px glow ring

gloom_spore_cap.read: broad flat mushroom cap, dark, with spores drifting off it
gloom_spore_cap.silhouette: wide low cap rows 5-9 spanning 12px, short 2px stalk rows 10-13
gloom_spore_cap.detail: 4-6 loose spore pixels above the cap, unattached to the silhouette; they are the read, so give them the brightest value on the sprite

iron_spike_thorn.read: low succulent rosette of straight rigid blades
iron_spike_thorn.silhouette: 5 blades fanning from a 3px base, each 1-2px wide, all straight (no curves — curves read as grass)
iron_spike_thorn.detail: one crimson barb at each blade TIP, with a single barb_shine pixel — the metal read comes from the hard light/dark step on the blades, not from a gradient
